name: Bless
description: Restores one person fully and doubles how fast they learn for a few days.

name: Inspire
description: A dream that makes one person far likelier to discover something new for a while.

name: Omen
description: A sign in the sky that sets what the whole tribe focuses on for a while.

name: Portal
description: Choose a party of up to five and a floor, and call them through the portal. Free, but the dungeon is deadly.
